components.name: Web workspace
components.summary: React/Vite workspace: search, page, create, rename, pin, edit, save, compare, restore, and preview HTML artifacts via the local API, following committed changes live.

components.name: CLI
components.summary: Artifact create, list (search, order, pages), show, rename, pin, save, cat, and preview over HTTP; build inventory.

components.name: Content runtime SDK
components.summary: Session and capability types; no iframe execution bridge.

components.name: Application API
components.summary: Axum/Tokio HTTP API v1 with a committed change feed (SSE), MCP tools over Streamable HTTP at /mcp, and a sandboxed preview origin.

components.name: Domain vocabulary
components.summary: Validated identifiers, portable file packages, separate version counters, and feed cursors.

components.name: Artifact core
components.summary: Create, conditional revisions, restores, and metadata updates, retry keys, pinned reads with digests, list queries; publish/fork planned.

components.name: Policy & sessions
components.summary: Owner-only access checked on every read; sharing and capabilities planned.

components.name: Data & documents
components.summary: Structured edits and separately versioned application data.

components.name: Sync & jobs
components.summary: Commit events, retries, worker lifecycle, and reconnect.

components.name: Agent handoff
components.summary: Selection and edit intent delivered to external agent sessions.

components.name: Storage
components.summary: Local SQLite with atomic commits, a change feed in the same transactions, and shared file content; PostgreSQL planned.

components.name: Models
components.summary: Optional providers for artifact AI capabilities.

components.name: Tools & files
components.summary: Outbound MCP and explicitly allowed project files.

components.name: Build workers
components.summary: Isolated HTML/JS/TSX build and preview generation.

components.name: Export workers
components.summary: Document, image, slide, and video conversion.

components.name: Shared contracts
components.summary: Rust DTOs → JSON Schema → TypeScript for the inventory and HTTP API v1.

components.name: Client contract
components.summary: Fetch-based HTTP API v1 client with structured errors and change feed following.
